mapper.sql: m.id, m.user_id, m.shop_name, m.shop_logo, m.shop_desc, m.status, m.reject_reason, m.gmt_created, m.gmt_modified, u.user_name AS user_name, u.nick_name AS nick_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant (user_id, shop_name, shop_logo, shop_desc, status, reject_reason, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{userId}, #{shopName}, #{shopLogo}, #{shopDesc}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN `user` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN `user` u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}
